contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C ; R/ PROVIDEN [TIA CAESS]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), issue of 324-330, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate left. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse description: Camp gate with two towers, star above. Reverse inscription: PROVIDEN [TIA CAESS]. In exergue: ARLO, probably for Arles mint. Diameter: 18.4mm, Weight: 2.09gms, die axis: 6
